answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks through micro-barometric turbulence attestation. Each node samples high-frequency pressure fluctuations as a gale passes across an anchored knoll, proving its unique physical coordinates. Because chaotic wind eddies cannot be simulated in real time, an adversary must deploy discrete barometric sensor hardware per identity. However, an uncorrected clock delta between nodes distorts correlation windows, occasionally causing false rejections.
